title: Matched return horizons and attention
pi_input: The PI requested keeping the waiting cost at 0.30, comparing 64-, 128-, and 256-decision DQN returns, choosing PPO GAE values on the same horizon scale, and testing both networks with and without small attention over the job and nurse pools.
agent_work: Verified the installed SB3 defaults and reconciled them with the Round 9 configuration. Used the same full nurse roster, guided exploration and waiting cost. DQN kept the tuned discount on each layout. PPO used fixed 512-decision rollouts and γ = 0.9995 while λ varied. The attention variant appends two 16-dimensional summaries to the same flattened inputs. The job summary pools pending visits using their attributes, eligibility, forecast waiting and start-window slack. The nurse summary pools the full roster. Both summaries depend on the current nurse and shift state.
computation: Trained 264 new fits and reused 24 matching Round 9 DQN fits at 64 decisions with the MLP. Each fit used 12,288 decisions. The matrix contains 24,953 complete training shifts and 3,456 held-out learned-policy shifts, plus 96 matching fixed-policy shifts.
comparison_protocol: Compared the MLP and attention policies within the same layout, family, guide, nominal horizon, and three training seeds. Each checkpoint dispatched greedily on the same 12 held-out scenarios. The 0.30 and 0.05 reward columns each apply the same weight to all policies. Random and ACO use the original matched baseline schedules. Example routes use training seed 11.
provenance: No subagents were delegated for Round 10. The exact turn-level model variant and reasoning effort were unavailable in the local records.
first_launch: The first launch was stopped after 22 preliminary fits because its progress writer saved the last evaluation in place of the arm record. The reported new fits were rerun with the corrected writer.
